nodes.label: Pain Point: Navigation Paradigm Friction
nodes.rationale: Floating hamburger drawer forces a full-screen overlay on desktop, blocking side-by-side scanning and increasing cognitive friction during emergency triage; resolved via a responsive dual-state nav (persistent sidebar desktop / bottom bar mobile).

nodes.label: Pain Point: Header Redundancy & Visual Clutter
nodes.rationale: RoleHomeHeader is duplicated across 6 pages, consuming 60-80px vertical space and shipping a non-functional Arabic toggle; centralizing into one top app header reduces clutter and consolidates identity/notifications/hotline.

nodes.label: Pain Point: Fragmented Clinical & Managerial Dashboards
nodes.rationale: Dashboard.tsx (780 lines) and DepartmentPage.tsx duplicate HoD queue logic while ERDashboard.tsx is isolated, forcing clinicians/managers to switch pages for identical daily tasks; resolved via role-focused unified cockpits.

nodes.label: Pain Point: Disconnected Forms & Split Mobile/Desktop Logic
nodes.rationale: NewReferralPage.tsx (1086 lines) maintains two full separate form trees for mobile vs desktop, doubling maintenance overhead and causing inconsistent validation; resolved via a unified responsive 4-step stepper.

nodes.label: Pain Point: Bed Management & Direct Admission Fragmentation
nodes.rationale: Walk-in admission requires navigating to a separate /admissions/new route from bed occupancy management, bouncing nurses between two URLs; resolved by merging into one Integrated Bed & Capacity Hub.

nodes.label: Pain Point: Referral List & Detail Disconnect
nodes.rationale: The referrals list causes a full-page transition to /referrals/:id with no true master-detail split view; resolved via a Master-Detail Clinical Workspace.
